reason: Good that the alarm works offline and there is a real button, that answers my first worry. But my phone already does alarm, weather and calendar for free, and I'm not paying 120 euros to move it to another room when I could just put it on the other side of the bed.
objection: It does what my phone already does, for 120 euros, and I would still own the phone. A founding batch of a first product from a new company also means no track record on support or software updates.
would_change_my_mind: A price under about 70 euros, or reviews from real owners after a few months showing the briefing is actually useful and it kept working.
